title: HTTP error spans per Jaeger service
description: Spans in the look-back window whose HTTP status is 4xx or 5xx, per service and operation, from the Jaeger query API. Pass 1 searches every service for error=true (5xx server spans flagged as errors, whatever the code); pass 2 searches the 4xx codes in statusCodes by exact match; every span with a status from 400 to 599 in a returned trace is counted. Tag values other than the status code, the operation, the service name and the URL path are never returned.

viewedFrom.description: The pod whose query API was asked (queryPod.name)

statusCodes.description: Codes searched by exact match in pass 2

statusKeys.description: The span attributes the status was searched on

queriedCount.description: Services whose pass 1 query finished (their counts are real, possibly incomplete: see complete)

truncated.description: services were cut at maxItems and not queried

unknownServices.description: Names in the services input that Jaeger does not know

excludedServices.description: Names in excludeServices that Jaeger knows

serverErrorSpans.description: Total over the queried services: inbound (not span.kind client) spans with status 500 to 599

clientErrorSpans.description: Total over the queried services: inbound spans with status 400 to 499

queried.description: false when the service's first query failed or was not asked before the deadline (see errors); its counts are then null

complete.description: every planned query for the service finished; false when it ran out of budget or a query failed (the counts of the finished queries are kept)

queriesPlanned.description: 1 (error=true) plus one per searched code and status attribute key

tracesSeen.description: Distinct traces the service's queries returned (every search, whatever status they hold)

limitReached.description: a query returned `limit` traces: the counts are a lower bound

operation.description: The span's operation name, query strings and ids in paths removed, cut at 1024 characters

serverErrorSpans.description: Inbound spans with a status of 500 or more

clientErrorSpans.description: Inbound spans with a status of 400 to 499

outboundErrorSpans.description: span.kind client spans with status 400 to 599

outboundByStatus.description: Outbound span count per status code

urlPaths.description: Distinct URL paths of the inbound spans: http.route when the span has it, else the raw path with ;params, query string and fragment removed and id-like segments replaced by {id}

truncated.description: the operation name or a path was cut at 1024 characters

operations.description: Operations with at least one error span, most server errors first

services.description: Queried services first, most server errors first; capped at maxItems

queryPod.description: The pod asked, and how long its store has been collecting: an in-memory Jaeger is empty after a restart

container.description: The container taken as Jaeger (its image is Jaeger's, else the first that is not a sidecar)

containerStartedAt.description: When the container's current run started

storageMayBeSharded.description: More than one replica and an image that keeps spans in the pod (all-in-one: memory or Badger): each pod then holds only its share and the counts are those of the pod asked

storageBasis.description: Why storageMayBeSharded is true (read from the image name only)

completeCount.description: Services whose every planned query finished

servicesNotQueried.description: Services selected but not queried (beyond maxItems, or whose first query failed or was not asked)

limitReached.description: Some service had a query that returned `limit` traces: its counts are a lower bound

outboundErrorSpans.description: Total over the queried services: span.kind client spans with status 400 to 599 (the service's own calls to others)
